question: Should OpenClaw publish `runIsolatedCompletion` as a supported agent-harness and trusted Plugin Runtime contract, or should the zero-tool path remain private to the built-in owners that need it?
rationale: The branch makes a durable plugin-facing API addition, while the available discussion and prior review provide implementation and proof evidence but no maintainer decision on the permanent API boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the public contract
options.body: Approve the additive harness and Plugin Runtime capability, with the documented fail-closed semantics treated as the supported compatibility contract.

options.title: Keep the path core-private
options.body: Refactor the call path so built-in owners can provide isolated completion without exposing a new general plugin contract.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Hold the PR until an owner defines which external runtime owners, if any, must implement the capability and how compatibility will be maintained.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the public contract
recommendation.body: Approve the additive harness and Plugin Runtime capability, with the documented fail-closed semantics treated as the supported compatibility contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Copilot auth work and this branch's implementation make this the strongest available routing candidate, though final API sponsorship requires a maintainer decision.
